name: 61053 · Mt Carroll, IL
findings: ZIP 61053 (Mt Carroll) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61053 (Mt Carroll) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 61053 (Mt Carroll) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
